candidate.publicInterface: evaluateRestrictedExecution({ actor, taskId, laneSessionId, executionClass, executable, argv, cwd, declaredOutputs, adapterCapability }): { decision: "allow" | "deny", reasonCode, approvedAtmCommand, receipt: atm.restrictedExecutionReceipt.v1 }
candidate.rollback: Revert the gateway module together with all five projections (Team worker executor, editor pre-tool hook, broker command-manifest execution, team runtime dispatch capability, next guidance) plus the three canonical skill templates as one unit. Do not restore a policy-only integration guard while claiming the external-worker execution surface is still hard-gated: partial revert reintroduces the TASK-GIT-0013 gap where an external worker can reach node -e / PowerShell / raw Git without crossing any guard.
causalValidators: fail-closed-mutation: raw git commit/push/reset/restore/clean, node -e/--eval, powershell -Command Set-Content, pwsh -Command, cmd /c, and bash -c are denied before process launch for every mutating execution class

no-shell-less-eval-loophole: a command manifest whose executable is process.execPath and whose argv contains an evaluation argument is denied; the previous positive write fixture is replaced by a fail-closed regression

allowlisted-read-only-validator: a declared read-only validator with structured argv, declared cwd, and no generic shell fallback is admitted, and the same validator with an appended shell escape is denied
text-is-not-authority: an override phrase, warning sentence, prompt text, or environment variable embedded in the command or context never flips a deny to an allow
authority-required: missing or mismatched actor, taskId, laneSessionId, declared outputs, or an adapter advertising externalWriteCapability unsupported fails closed for external write classes
adapter-parity: the Team worker adapter and the supported editor pre-tool adapter return the same normalized decision, reasonCode, and approvedAtmCommand for the same executable/argv
receipt-hygiene: denial receipts carry the normalized executable/argv class, actor/task/lane, reason code, and safe ATM recovery command without echoing reusable privileged tokens

seam.proposedInterface: evaluateRestrictedExecution({ actor, taskId, laneSessionId, executionClass, executable, argv, cwd, declaredOutputs, adapterCapability }): { decision: "allow" | "deny", reasonCode, approvedAtmCommand, receipt: atm.restrictedExecutionReceipt.v1 }
proposedAdapters: team-worker-process-adapter: packages/core/src/team-agents/worker-executor.ts maps a TeamWorkerExecutionLane (taskId, laneSessionId, coordinator actor) plus the requested executable/argv into evaluateRestrictedExecution and refuses process launch on deny

editor-pre-tool-adapter: packages/cli/src/commands/integration-hooks/implementation.ts tokenizes the pre-tool command into executable/argv, calls the same gateway, and projects decision.reasonCode plus approvedAtmCommand into the blocking hook result instead of keeping a private deny list
seam.deletionTest: If this module is deleted, the policy and caller complexity must reappear across callers; otherwise the module is too shallow.
seam.interfaceTest: Replace internals through the proposed interface and assert observable behavior through that interface only.

hiddenComplexity.leverage: Concentrate repeated policy behind one interface so callers gain more behavior per fact learned.
hiddenComplexity.locality: Keep fixes, rollback, and causal validator updates inside the owner atom or map.

replaceDontLayerTest: Replace old private-internal tests with tests through the proposed interface once the adapters exist; do not layer tests over old shallow modules.
